title: AIS record corrections
description: Your AIS record (years at AIS, division, graduation) can only be changed by the committee. If something is wrong, send a correction request with the right values.
noRecord: You have no AIS record to correct.
submitted: Your request was sent. The committee will review it.
pending: Correction requested on {date}. Waiting for the committee.

hints.reason: Tell the committee what is wrong, e.g. "I left in 2015, not 2014."
hints.teacherYearsTo: Leave empty if you still work at AIS.

fieldErrors.yearsOrder: The end year must be the same as or after the start year.

errors.noChanges: Change at least one value before sending.
errors.pendingExists: You already have a pending request for this record.
errors.alreadyDecided: This request has already been decided.

decided.approved: Approved and applied to the member's record.
decided.rejected: Rejected. The member has been notified.

rejected.subject: About your AIS record correction request
